description.en: RDF version of the Apertium bilingual dictionary FR-CA. The original dataset (in LMF) comes from http://hdl.handle.net/10230/17097 . The RDF version of the lexica is modelled using lemon (http://lemon-model.net/) and the translation module (http://purl.org/net/translation). More about the Apertium RDF dictionaries at http://linguistic.linkeddata.es/apertium/

contact_point.name: Jimmy O'Reagan; Eleka Ingenieritza Linguistikoa S.L.; Universitat d'Alacant. Grup Transducens; Prompsit Language Engineering S.L.; Universitat Pompeu Fabra. Institut Universitari de Lingüiística Aplicada (IULA)

other_download.title: French lexicon URI
other_download.description: This online lexicon not only contains the FR lexical entries from the FR-CA bilingual dictionary (that can be found in the zipped dump) but also aggregates the lexical entries in FR coming from all the published Apertium RDF dictionaries.
